# ScriptClientHand

*Client*

First-person hand of the local player, from `c.getPlayer().getHand("main")` or `getHand("off")`: moves, turns and hides the hand and its item, at once or smoothly. [`reset()`](#reset) restores the default hand.

## Methods

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Moves the hand from its usual place at once.

```js
c.getPlayer().getHand("main").setPosition(0, -0.2, 0); // lowered a bit
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset to the right, in blocks of the first-person view |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset up |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset towards the viewer |

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation}

::: member

Turns the hand at once, after its offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around x, in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around y, in degrees |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around z, in degrees |

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the current offset of the hand

:::

### getRotation {#getrotation}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the current rotation in degrees: x pitch, y yaw, z roll

:::

### moveTo {#moveto}

::: member

Smoothly moves the hand to an offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `delay` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset to the right, in blocks of the first-person view |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset up |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | offset towards the viewer |

:::

### rotateTo {#rotateto}

::: member

Smoothly turns the hand.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `delay` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around x, in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around y, in degrees |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around z, in degrees |

:::

### setForm {#setform}

::: member

Draws a form instead of the hand in first person, wherever Minecraft draws the arm: an empty hand and the arms holding a map (with an item in the hand no arm is drawn). The form is placed like a whole player standing where the camera is, so in a form with the player's proportions (e.g. a player model showing only the arm) the arm lands on the usual hand. Its transform moves it from there, and its animations play. The offset and rotation of this hand apply to the form too. Only this client sees it; it is saved with the client data of the player.

```js
var form = scram.form('{"id":"bbs:model","model":"my_arm"}');

c.getPlayer().getHand("main").setForm(form);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to copy, or `null` to draw the usual hand again |

:::

### getForm {#getform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — the form drawn instead of the hand, see [`setForm(BBSForm)`](#setform); changes to it show at once; `null` if the usual hand is drawn

:::

### reset {#reset}

::: member

Puts the hand back to its usual place and rotation, shows it and its item again, turns its swing back on and removes its form.

:::

### setRender {#setrender}

::: member

Shows or hides the hand with its item in first person.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the hand is drawn |

:::

### setRenderItem {#setrenderitem}

::: member

Shows or hides the held item; the hand stays.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderItem` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the item is drawn |

:::

### setSwingArm {#setswingarm}

::: member

Turns the swing animation of the first-person hand (hitting, using items) on or off; while off, the hand and its item stay still when the player swings. Only the first-person view changes: other players and the third-person view still see the swing, and the hit itself happens as usual.

```js
c.getPlayer().getHand("main").setSwingArm(false);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `swingArm` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the hand swings; `true` by default |

:::

### isSwingArm {#isswingarm}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the first-person hand plays the swing animation, see [`setSwingArm(boolean)`](#setswingarm)

:::

### isRender {#isrender}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the hand is drawn

:::

### isRenderItem {#isrenderitem}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the held item is drawn

:::
